info.title: Cisco NDFC REST API
info.description: Cisco Nexus Dashboard Fabric Controller (NDFC) REST API — fabric lifecycle, VRF and network provisioning, interface configuration, switch inventory and discovery, policy management, image management (ISSU), config templates, and feature manager.
info.x-itential-curated: Hand-authored from the CiscoDevNet/ansible-dcnm Ep* endpoint class inventory (github.com/CiscoDevNet/ansible-dcnm, plugins/module_utils/common/api/v1/) and the dcnm_network/vrf/interface/policy/inventory module source files. No official standalone OpenAPI spec is published by Cisco — the live Swagger UI is available in-product at https://<ndfc-host>/apidocs/.

ndfc_host.description: Hostname or IP of the Nexus Dashboard running NDFC

ApiKeyAuth.name: X-Nd-Apikey
ApiKeyAuth.description: NDFC API key. Must be paired with X-Nd-Username on every request.

ApiUsernameAuth.name: X-Nd-Username
ApiUsernameAuth.description: NDFC username associated with the API key.
